stem: Alder Mutual's workspace runs Terraform on engineers' workstations, and HCP Terraform only stores the state. The team now wants HCP Terraform to check on its own schedule whether real infrastructure still matches the configuration. What must change?

choices.text: Enable cost estimation for the workspace
Switch the workspace to Remote or Agent execution mode
Attach a post-apply run task that scans for drift
Create an audit trail token and read the audit log on a schedule

rationale: Health assessments are the scheduled version of drift detection, and the docs require a workspace in Remote execution mode or Agent execution mode. A workspace whose runs execute on workstations in Local mode does not meet that requirement; this follows from the requirement, and the docs do not name Local mode. Cost estimation only adds an estimate as an extra phase between the plan and the apply and is off by default. A run task is an external service called at a stage of a run, not a scheduled check by HCP Terraform. Audit trails record who changed workspaces and runs, and they do not compare real infrastructure with the configuration.
